The Bachelor of Business Administration - Business Data Analytics delivers the essential business skills and data-driven expertise that students need to advance their career.

The program prepares students to answer important questions that arise in decision making in business and the public sector that can be informed by economics and analyzed using data. They will receive hands-on training in business decision modeling and the most current analytical tools that are in high demand by employers today.
5q9v:
Nursing may be the major for those who want to help others in a hands-on way, are calm, patient, and empathetic and not overwhelmed by fast-paced environments.

The Nursing program at Utica University offers a very rigorous program of foundational study, practical training, and clinical experience in the discipline, complemented by comprehensive learning in the liberal arts. Nursing students have access to the university's state-of-the-art Albert and Gloria Shaheen Nursing Laboratory, which features a fully equipped hospital ward and advanced learning technologies. They work closely with exceptionally accomplished faculty.
5s12:
The Master of Business Administration (MBA) program gives students practical skills through classroom and hands-on learning experiences. In this hybrid program, they will explore fundamental business principles and focused studies in one of the specializations. For those who are interested in more generalized business studies or want to create their own focused area of study, follow the general studies track and choose their own electives.

MBA foundations courses have a live, campus-based classroom component taught in the beautifully refurbished and historic Clark City Center campus. These live meetings provide students the opportunity to meet with peers, faculty members, and members of the local business community to explore contemporary business practices and issues.
